decisions.summary: Make AzureDiagnostics KQL queries resilient to both Dedicated and Resource-Specific / AdditionalFields column shapes across Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting.
decisions.rationale: Uses column_ifexists(), coalesce(), and todynamic() fallbacks so queries execute cleanly regardless of whether DDoS diagnostic telemetry lands in flat columns or AdditionalFields/ResultDescription JSON.

decisions.summary: Convert both Azure DDoS Protection Analytic Rules into Defender XDR Custom Detections under Solutions/Azure DDoS Protection/XDR Detections/ and Solutions/Azure DDoS Protection/Workbooks/XDR Workbooks/.
decisions.rationale: Preserves exact detection thresholds, entity mappings, and MITRE techniques while adding Timestamp/ReportId projections for Graph Custom Detection compatibility.
